citations.snippet: AI beats humans on some benchmarks but trails on complex reasoning and planning. Industry produces 51 notable ML models while academia produces 15. Frontier model training costs reach tens of millions. Generative AI investment surges to $25.2 billion.

citations.sourceTitle: World Economic Forum Future of Jobs
citations.snippet: WEF discusses job displacement and creation under AI adoption and emphasizes reskilling. Analytical thinking and creative thinking are the most important skills for workers. 44% of workers' core skills are expected to change by 2027.

Automation changes task composition; many occupations are transformed rather than fully replaced. By 2030, up to 30% of hours worked globally could be automated. Generative AI accelerates automation potential for knowledge work.
